mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url AS cover, c.owner_id, COALESCE(owner_profile.nickname, owner_user.username) AS ownerName, c.status, c.created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.user_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS posts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS logs, CASE WHEN my_cm.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_member

FROM circles c LEFT JOIN circle_members cm ON cm.circle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN travel_logs l ON l.circle_id = c.id AND l.status = 1 LEFT JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles owner_profile ON owner_profile.user_id = owner_user.id LEFT JOIN circle_members my_cm ON my_cm.circle_id = c.id AND my_cm.user_id = #{currentUserId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE c.status = 1
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url, c.owner_id, owner_profile.nickname, owner_user.username, c.status, c.created_at, my_cm.user_id ORDER BY members DESC, posts DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url, c.owner_id, owner_profile.nickname, owner_user.username, c.status, c.created_at, my_cm.user_id ORDER BY c.status DESC, members DESC, posts DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circles c LEFT JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles owner_profile ON owner_profile.user_id = owner_user.id

SELECT
WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url, c.owner_id, owner_profile.nickname, owner_user.username, c.status, c.created_at, my_cm.user_id

SELECT
WHERE c.id = #{id} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover_url, c.owner_id, owner_profile.nickname, owner_user.username, c.status, c.created_at, my_cm.user_id

SELECT cm.user_id, cm.role, cm.joined_at, COALESCE(up.nickname, u.username) AS username, up.avatar_url AS avatar FROM circle_members cm JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.id WHERE cm.circle_id = #{circleId} ORDER BY cm.role DESC, cm.joined_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circles WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT owner_id FROM circles WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circles (name, description, cover_url, owner_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{ownerId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO circle_members (circle_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{circleId}, #{userId}, #{role})
